create.title: Create Bank Account
create.description: Use this form to define a new bank account.

update.title: Update Bank Account
update.description: Use this form to update an existing bank account.

descriptions.name: The name of the bank.
descriptions.bic: The BIC code of the bank.
descriptions.rib: The account number of the bank account.
descriptions.iban: The IBAN code of the bank account.
descriptions.currency: The currency of the bank account.

create.title: Create Tax Rate
create.description: Use this form to define a new tax rate.

update.title: Update Tax Rate
update.description: Use this form to update an existing tax rate.

descriptions.label: A unique name for the tax (e.g., VAT, FODEC).
descriptions.value: The value of the tax (e.g., 10 for 10%).
descriptions.type: The type of tax (percentage or fixed amount).
descriptions.special: A special tax is applied on the amount after normal taxes have already been calculated.
descriptions.specificCurrency: Set a specific currency for this tax.
descriptions.currency: The currency associated with this tax rate.

delete.title: Delete Tax Rate
delete.description: This action is irreversible and permanent. Deleting this tax rate will affect all associated products and services. Please proceed with caution.
